newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel cabinet likely to meet on budget next week.
newsitem.headline: Israel cabinet likely to meet on budget next week.

text.p: Israeli Finance Minister Dan Meridor and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu plan to present the cabinet on May 23 with a proposal to cut the 1997 budget, sources in the prime minister's office said on Wednesday.

Senior economic officials will have to meet before then to work out details of the cut. Treasury officials believe a cut of less than one billion shekels will be needed to guarantee the government does not overshoot its budget deficit target this year, set at 2.8 percent of gross domestic product.
The government had a deficit of 928 million shekels in the first four months of the year.
The 1997 budget of 197 billion shekels already includes a seven billion shekel cut.
